```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

# Read in config file
config<-readLines(params$config_file)

# Identify outdir
outdir<-gsub('outdir: ','', config[grepl('outdir: ',config)])

# Read in results package
output<-readRDS(paste0(outdir,'/results/results_package.rds'))

# Read in GWAS list
gwas_list<-fread(gsub('gwas_list: ','', config[grepl('gwas_list: ',config)]))

# Determine which analyses were requested
clump_logical<-config[grepl('clump:',config)] == "clump: T"

cojo_logical<-config[grepl('cojo:',config)] == "cojo: T"

finemap_logical<-config[grepl('finemap:',config)] == "finemap: T"

ldsc_logical<-config[grepl('ldsc:',config)] == "ldsc: T"

magma_gene_logical<-config[grepl('magma_gene:',config)] == "magma_gene: T"

twas_panel_psychencode_logical<-config[grepl('twas_panel_psychencode:',config)] == "twas_panel_psychencode: T"
twas_panel_fusion_logical<-config[grepl('twas_panel_fusion:',config)] == "twas_panel_fusion: T"

twas_logical<-any(twas_panel_psychencode_logical, twas_panel_fusion_logical)

twas_conditional_logical<-config[grepl('twas_conditional:',config)] == "twas_conditional: T" & twas_logical == T

smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_psychencode:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_psychencode: T"

smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus: T"
smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord: T"

smr_expression_panel_eqtlgen_logical<-config[grepl('smr_expression_panel_eqtlgen:',config)] == "smr_expression_panel_eqtlgen: T"

pwas_panel_rosmap_logical<-config[grepl('pwas_panel_rosmap:',config)] == "pwas_panel_rosmap: T"
pwas_panel_banner_logical<-config[grepl('pwas_panel_banner:',config)] == "pwas_panel_banner: T"

smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical<-config[grepl('smr_protein_panel_rosmap:',config)] == "smr_protein_panel_rosmap: T"

magma_drugtargetor_logical<-config[grepl('magma_drugtargetor:',config)] == "magma_drugtargetor: T"
twas_gsea_lincs_logical<-config[grepl('twas_gsea_lincs:',config)] == "twas_gsea_lincs: T"
twas_so_lincs_logical<-config[grepl('twas_so_lincs:',config)] == "twas_so_lincs: T"

dgi_db_comp_logical<-config[grepl('dgi_db_comp:',config)] == "dgi_db_comp: T"

twas_gsea_drugtargetor_logical<-config[grepl('twas_gsea_drugtargetor:',config)] == "twas_gsea_drugtargetor: T"

# Summarise this information
mol_assoc_logical<-any(magma_gene_logical,
                       twas_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical,
                       smr_expression_panel_eqtlgen_logical,
                       pwas_panel_rosmap_logical,
                       pwas_panel_banner_logical,
                       smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical)

metabrain_logical<-any(smr_expression_panel_metabrain_basalganglia_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cerebellum_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_cortex_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_hippocampus_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_metabrain_spinalcord_logical)

smr_expression_logical<-any(smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical,
                         metabrain_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_eqtlgen_logical)

expression_logical<-any( twas_logical,
                         smr_expression_logical)

psychencode_logical<-any(twas_panel_psychencode_logical,
                         smr_expression_panel_psychencode_logical)

protein_logical<-any( pwas_panel_rosmap_logical,
                      pwas_panel_banner_logical,
                      smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical)

drug_logical<-any(dgi_db_comp_logical, 
                  magma_drugtargetor_logical,
                  twas_gsea_lincs_logical,
                  twas_so_lincs_logical,
                  twas_gsea_drugtargetor_logical)

```

# GWAS QC

This table shows descriptive statistics for the submitted GWAS.

```{r, eval=T, echo=F}

# Create a table showing key statistics
qc_val<-data.table(name=params$gwas,
                   label=gwas_list$label[gwas_list$name == params$gwas],
                   n_var_orig=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$cleaner_dat$val$n_var_orig,
                   build=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$cleaner_dat$val$build$build,
                   n_snp_final=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$cleaner_dat$val$n_snp_final,
                   lambda_gc=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$focus_dat$val$lambda_gc,
                   max_chi2=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$focus_dat$val$max_chi2,
                   n_sig_snp=output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$focus_dat$val$n_sig_snp,
                   obs_h2=paste0(round(output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$ldsc_dat$val$obs_h2_est,3), " (",round(output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$ldsc_dat$val$obs_h2_se,3),")"),
                   int=paste0(round(output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$ldsc_dat$val$int_est,3), " (",round(output[[params$gwas]]$gwas_qc$ldsc_dat$val$int_se,3),")"))

names(qc_val)<-c('GWAS Name',
                 'GWAS Label',
                 'N variants pre-QC',
                 'Identified genome build',
                 'N variants post-QC',
                 'Lambda GC',
                 'Max. chi^2',
                 'N genome-wide significant variants',
                 "LDSC SNP-heritability (SE; observed scale)",
                 "LDSC intercept (SE)")

qc_val<-t(qc_val)
qc_val<-data.table(Parameter=dimnames(qc_val)[[1]],
                   Value=qc_val[,1])

datatable(qc_val, options = list(dom = 't', 
                                 ordering=F), 
            selection = 'none', 
            rownames = F, 
            colnames = '') %>%
  formatStyle(columns = c("Parameter"), fontWeight = 'bold', textAlign = "center") %>%
  formatStyle(columns = c("Value"), textAlign = "center")

```

```{r,  results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=any(clump_logical, cojo_logical)}

cat("*** \n")
cat("# SNP associations \n")
cat("This section list independent SNP associations achieving either genome-wide or suggestive significance. Independence is determined using [LD-based clumping](https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/1.9/postproc#clump) and/or conditional-joint ([COJO](https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO](https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO)) analysis. Note, LD is estimated using a reference sample and may not accurately reflect the LD structure in the GWAS sample. COJO analysis is particularly sensitive to LD mispecification. \n")

```

```{r, echo=F, comment='', eval=clump_logical}

clump_lead_snps<-output[[params$gwas]]$snp_assoc$clump

clump_lead_snps<-clump_lead_snps[clump_lead_snps$P < 1e-5,]

clump_lead_snps<-clump_lead_snps[order(clump_lead_snps$CHR, clump_lead_snps$BP),]

clump_lead_snps$BETA<-round(clump_lead_snps$BETA,3)
clump_lead_snps$SE<-round(clump_lead_snps$SE,3)
clump_lead_snps$FREQ<-NULL
clump_lead_snps$REF.FREQ<-NULL
clump_lead_snps$N<-NULL

clump_lead_snps_gw<-clump_lead_snps[clump_lead_snps$P < 5e-8,]
    
```

```{r,  results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=finemap_logical}

cat("*** \n")
cat("## SNP Finemapping \n")
cat("This section summarises the results SNP-based statistical finemapping, using the software [SuSiE](https://stephenslab.github.io/susie-paper/). Note, LD is estimated using a reference sample and may not accurately reflect the LD structure in the GWAS sample. Finemapping analysis with multiple causal variants (L>1) is particularly sensitive to LD mispecification. Below we also provide finemapping results assuming a single causal variant (i.e. L=1), which is robust to LD mispecification but has reduced power when more than one causal variant is present. \n\n")

cat("<details><summary>Finemapping (L<10): All loci</summary> \n")

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=any(expression_logical,protein_logical), echo=F}

cat("*** \n")
cat("## Summary of Molecular Associations \n")
cat("This section summarises gene-level association results from MAGMA, TWAS, PWAS, and SMR. This simply shows the whether genes showed a statistically significant association with the GWAS phenotype, and for TWAS/PWAS/SMR whether the association for gene expression/protein levels and the GWAS phenotype colocalised (same causal variant) and are thereby consistent with a causal model. \n\n")

```

```{r, eval=any(expression_logical,protein_logical), echo=F, message=F, warning=F, comment=F}

all_func_res<-NULL
types<-NULL

if(finemap_logical){

  finemap_L1_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = "SuSie (L=1)",
                          ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$finemap$L1,
                          Z=1,
                          Sig=F,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method="SNP\nFine-mapping",
                          Type='')
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, finemap_L1_tmp)
  
  if(nrow(finemap_L1_tmp) > 0){
    types<-c(types, "SuSiE")
  }

}

if(twas_logical){
  
  twas_tmp<-data.table(Panel=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$fusion$res$PANEL,
                       ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$fusion$res$`Gene Symbol`,
                       Z=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$fusion$res$TWAS.Z,
                       Sig=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$fusion$res$TWAS.P.FDR < 0.05,
                       Coloc=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$fusion$res$COLOC_logical)
  
  twas_tmp$Method<-'FUSION'
  twas_tmp$Type<-'Expr.'
  twas_tmp$Type[grepl('SPLIC',twas_tmp$Panel)]<-'Splice'
  
  # Retain only the most significant assoc for each gene within PANEL (only relevent for splice panel)
  twas_tmp<-twas_tmp[order(-abs(twas_tmp$Z)),]
  twas_tmp<-twas_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(twas_tmp$Panel, twas_tmp$ID)),]
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, twas_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "FUSION\nExpr.")
  if(any(twas_tmp$Type == 'Splice')){
    types<-c(types, "FUSION\nSplice")
  }
}

if(smr_expression_logical){
  # SMR expression
  smr_expression_res_tmp<-data.table(Panel=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$PANEL,
                                     ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$`Gene Symbol`,
                                     Z=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$b_SMR/output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$se_SMR,
                                     Sig=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$p_SMR.FDR < 0.05,
                                     Coloc=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$exp$smr$res$p_HEIDI > 0.05)
  
  smr_expression_res_tmp$Method<-'SMR'
  smr_expression_res_tmp$Type<-'Expr.'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, smr_expression_res_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "SMR\nExpr.")

}

# PWAS
if(pwas_panel_rosmap_logical & !(pwas_panel_rosmap_logical & pwas_panel_banner_logical)){
  
  pwas_tmp<-data.table( Panel=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$fusion$res$PANEL,
                       ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$fusion$res$`Gene Symbol`,
                       Z=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$fusion$res$pwas_all.Z,
                       Sig=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$fusion$res$pwas_all.P.FDR < 0.05,
                       Coloc=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$fusion$res$COLOC_logical)
    
  pwas_tmp<-pwas_tmp[order(-abs(pwas_tmp$Z)),]
  pwas_tmp<-pwas_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(pwas_tmp$Panel, pwas_tmp$ID)),]
  pwas_tmp$Method<-'FUSION'
  pwas_tmp$Type<-'Protein'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, pwas_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "FUSION\nProtein")
}

if(smr_protein_panel_rosmap_logical){
  
  # SMR protein
  smr_protein_res_tmp<-data.table(Panel=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$PANEL,
                                   ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$`Gene Symbol`,
                                   Z=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$b_SMR/output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$se_SMR,
                                   Sig=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$p_SMR.FDR < 0.05,
                                   Coloc=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$protein$smr$res$p_HEIDI > 0.05)
  
  smr_protein_res_tmp<-smr_protein_res_tmp[order(-abs(smr_protein_res_tmp$Z)),]
  smr_protein_res_tmp<-smr_protein_res_tmp[!duplicated(paste0(smr_protein_res_tmp$Panel, smr_protein_res_tmp$ID)),]
  smr_protein_res_tmp$Method<-'SMR'
  smr_protein_res_tmp$Type<-'Protein'
  
  all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, smr_protein_res_tmp)

  types<-c(types, "SMR\nProtein")
}

types<-unique(types)

if(magma_gene_logical){

  magma_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = 'MAGMA',
                          ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$magma$ID,
                          Z=abs(qnorm(as.numeric(output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$magma$P))),
                          Sig=as.numeric(output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$magma$P.FDR) < 0.05,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method='MAGMA',
                          Type='')
  
    all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, magma_tmp)

    types<-c(types, "MAGMA")
}

if(clump_logical){
  
  nearest_tmp<-data.frame(Panel = 'NearestGene',
                          ID=output[[params$gwas]]$mol_assoc$nearest$clump,
                          Z=1,
                          Sig=F,
                          Coloc=F,
                          Method='Nearest\nGene',
                          Type='')
  
    all_func_res<-rbind(all_func_res, nearest_tmp)

    types<-c(types, "Nearest\nGene")
}

# Subset to high confidence genes
all_func_res<-all_func_res[all_func_res$ID %in% all_func_res$ID[which((all_func_res$Sig == T & all_func_res$Coloc == T) | all_func_res$Panel == "SuSie (L=1)")],]

# Insert missing data
all_func_res_all<-NULL
for(i in unique(all_func_res$Panel)){
  for(j in unique(all_func_res$Method[all_func_res$Panel == i])){
    all_func_res_panel<-all_func_res[all_func_res$Panel == i & all_func_res$Method == j,]
    all_func_res_other<-all_func_res[!(all_func_res$Panel %in% all_func_res_panel$Panel) & !(all_func_res$Method %in% all_func_res_panel$Method),]
    all_func_res_other<-all_func_res_other[!(all_func_res_other$ID %in% all_func_res_panel$ID),]
    all_func_res_other<-unique(all_func_res_other$ID)
    all_func_res_panel_missing<-data.frame(ID=all_func_res_other)
  
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Panel=i
    all_func_res_panel_missing$ID=all_func_res_other
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Z=NA
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Sig=0
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Coloc=0
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Method=j
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Type=all_func_res_panel$Type[1]
    all_func_res_panel_missing$Group=all_func_res_panel$Group[1]
    
    all_func_res_panel_missing<-all_func_res_panel_missing[,names(all_func_res_panel)]
    
    all_func_res_all<-rbind(all_func_res_all,all_func_res_panel)
    all_func_res_all<-rbind(all_func_res_all,all_func_res_panel_missing)
  }
}

all_func_res_all$Group<-paste0(all_func_res_all$Method,'\n',all_func_res_all$Type )
all_func_res_all$Group[all_func_res_all$Group == 'SNP\nFine-mapping\n']<-'SuSiE'
all_func_res_all$Group[all_func_res_all$Group == 'MAGMA\n']<-'MAGMA'
all_func_res_all$Group[all_func_res_all$Group == 'Nearest\nGene\n']<-'Nearest\nGene'
all_func_res_all$Group<-factor(all_func_res_all$Group, levels=types)

all_func_res_all<-all_func_res_all[order(as.character(all_func_res_all$ID)),]

all_func_res_all$ID<-factor(all_func_res_all$ID, levels=unique(all_func_res_all$ID))

group_siz<-NULL
for(i in types[types %in% all_func_res_all$Group]){
  group_siz<-rbind(group_siz, data.frame(Group=i,
                           Size=length(unique(all_func_res_all$Panel[all_func_res_all$Group==i]))))
}

# Set minimum size to 3 to allow space for labels
group_siz$Size[group_siz$Size < 2]<-2
group_siz$Prop<-group_siz$Size/sum(group_siz$Size)
group_siz$Width<-4*group_siz$Prop

# Plot in chunks to make the plot exportable
chunks<-split(unique(all_func_res_all$ID), ceiling(seq_along(unique(all_func_res_all$ID))/70))
for(chunk_i in 1:length(chunks)){
  all_func_res_all_chunk_i<-all_func_res_all[all_func_res_all$ID %in% chunks[[chunk_i]],]
  all_func_res_all_chunk_i$ID<-factor(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$ID, levels=rev(unique(as.character(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$ID))))
    
  x<-c(min(all_func_res_all$Z, na.rm=T),0,max(all_func_res_all$Z, na.rm=T))
  x<-(x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))
  
  # Create second version of the plot
  heatmap<-ggplot(data = all_func_res_all_chunk_i, aes(x = Panel, y = ID)) +
  	theme_bw()	+
    geom_point(data=all_func_res_all_chunk_i[all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Sig == T,], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), colour='black', size=4) +
    geom_point(data=all_func_res_all_chunk_i[all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Coloc ==T & all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Sig == T,], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), colour='black', shape=15, size=5) +
    geom_point(data=all_func_res_all_chunk_i[(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Method == 'SNP\nFine-mapping' | all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Method == 'Nearest\nGene') & !(is.na(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Z)),], aes(x = Panel, y = ID), colour='#00FF00', size=4) +
  	geom_point(data=all_func_res_all_chunk_i[all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Method != 'SNP\nFine-mapping' & all_func_res_all_chunk_i$Method != 'Nearest\nGene',], aes(colour = Z), size=3) +
  	scale_colour_gradientn(colours=c("#0066FF","#0099FF","#FFFFFF","#FF6666","#FF0000"), na.value = NA,name = "Z-score", limits = c(min(all_func_res_all$Z, na.rm=T), max(all_func_res_all$Z, na.rm=T)), values=x) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(x='', y='') +
    facet_wrap(~ Group , nrow=1, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits= unique(rev(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$ID)))
  
  
  library(grid)
  gt = ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(heatmap))
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(group_siz)){
    gt$widths[gt$layout$l[grep(paste0('panel-',i,'-1'), gt$layout$name)]] = group_siz$Width[i]*gt$widths[gt$layout$l[grep(paste0('panel-',i,'-1'), gt$layout$name)]]
  
  }
  
  dir.create(paste0(outdir,'/results/',params$gwas,'/reports'), recursive=T)
  png(paste0(outdir,'/results/',params$gwas,'/reports/mol_assoc_',chunk_i,'.png'), units = 'px', res=300, height=50*length(unique(all_func_res_all_chunk_i$ID))+800, width=3500)
  
  grid.draw(gt)
  
  a<-dev.off()

}

txt<-paste0("In total, ",length(unique(all_func_res_all$ID))," unique genes have been identified as high confidence.\n\n")

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=any(twas_so_lincs_logical, twas_gsea_lincs_logical, magma_drugtargetor_logical)}

cat("*** \n")
cat("# Drug repurposing \n")
cat("This section shows results drug repurposing analyses. Several analysis approaches are available. The inferred differential expression results from TWAS can be compared to the drug-induced expression profiles from the [Connectivity Map](https://clue.io/), AKA LINCS, to identify drugs that induce expression profiles opposite expression profiles associated with the GWAS phenotype. Two methods are used to compare TWAS and CMAP profiles, including the [average rank based method from So et al.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28805813/) and [TWAS-GSEA from Pain et al](https://github.com/opain/TWAS-GSEA). An alternative approach is to use MAGMA to identify drugs that are enriched for connections to genes associated with the GWAS phenotype. We use the collection of bipartite gene-drug interactions collated by [DrugTargetor](https://drugtargetor.com/). Unlike the TWAS-CMAP approaches, the MAGMA based approach does not consider the direction of effect of the gene on the GWAS phenotype or the drug on the genes expression/function, so may highlight drugs that might increase risk of the GWAS phenotype. However, the MAGMA approach can use a broader and perhaps more reliable sources of drug-gene interaction databases. To help validate the approaches used for identifying drug repurposing oppurtunities, we test for enrichment of drugs within ATC classifications. \n\n")

```

  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$Panel<-i

###
# MAGMA
###

magma_gs_atc_level4<-fread(paste0('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Software/MyGit/GenoFunc/GenoFuncPipe/results/ALS_only/magma/magma_drug_targetor_atc_res_level4.csv'))
magma_gs_atc_level4$P.FDR<-p.adjust(magma_gs_atc_level4$P, method = 'fdr')
magma_gs_atc_level4$log10_P<--log10(magma_gs_atc_level4$P)
magma_gs_atc_level4$FDR_Sig<-magma_gs_atc_level4$P.FDR < 0.05
magma_gs_atc_level4$Nom_Sig<-magma_gs_atc_level4$P < 0.05
magma_gs_atc_level4$Name<-paste0(magma_gs_atc_level4$ATC,': ',magma_gs_atc_level4$Name)
magma_gs_atc_level4$Method<-'MAGMA'
magma_gs_atc_level4$Panel<-'MAGMA'

magma_gs_atc_level4<-magma_gs_atc_level4[,c("Name","log10_P","FDR_Sig","Nom_Sig","Method","Panel"), with=F]

###
# GCSC
###

gcsc_gs_atc_level4<-fread(paste0('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/GCSC/GCSC_Brain_Blood_ALS_only_atc_res_level4.csv'))
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$log10_P<--log10(gcsc_gs_atc_level4$P)
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$FDR_Sig<-gcsc_gs_atc_level4$P.FDR < 0.05
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$Nom_Sig<-gcsc_gs_atc_level4$P < 0.05
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$Name<-paste0(gcsc_gs_atc_level4$ATC,': ',gcsc_gs_atc_level4$Name)
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$Method<-'GCSC'
gcsc_gs_atc_level4$Panel<-'GCSC'

gcsc_gs_atc_level4<-gcsc_gs_atc_level4[,c("Name","log10_P","FDR_Sig","Nom_Sig","Method","Panel"), with=F]

###
# TWAS-GSEA
###

weights<-read.table(paste0('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Software/MyGit/GenoFunc/GenoFuncPipe/results/ALS_only/twas/list_of_weights.txt'))$V1
weights<-weights[!grepl('SPLIC',weights)]

gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4<-NULL
for(i in weights){
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc<-fread(paste0('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Software/MyGit/GenoFunc/GenoFuncPipe/results/ALS_only/twas/drugtargetor/twas_gsea_',i,'_res_atc_res_level4.csv'))
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$Panel<-i
  # Calc. one-sided p
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.oneside<-gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P/2
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.oneside[gsea_drugtargetor_atc$Estimate < 0] <- 1-gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.oneside[gsea_drugtargetor_atc$Estimate < 0]
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.FDR<-p.adjust(gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P, method = 'fdr')
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.FDR.onside<-p.adjust(gsea_drugtargetor_atc$P.onside, method = 'fdr')
  gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4<-rbind(gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4, gsea_drugtargetor_atc)
}

gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4$P.FDR_all<-p.adjust(gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4$P, method = 'fdr')
gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4$P.FDR.onside_all<-p.adjust(gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4$P.oneside, method = 'fdr')

gsea_gs_atc_level4<-gsea_drugtargetor_atc_all_level4
gsea_gs_atc_level4$log10_P<-sign(gsea_gs_atc_level4$Estimate)*-log10(gsea_gs_atc_level4$P)
gsea_gs_atc_level4$FDR_Sig<-gsea_gs_atc_level4$P.FDR_all < 0.05
gsea_gs_atc_level4$Nom_Sig<-gsea_gs_atc_level4$P < 0.05
gsea_gs_atc_level4$Name<-paste0(gsea_gs_atc_level4$ATC,': ',gsea_gs_atc_level4$Name)

gsea_gs_atc_level4$Method<-'TWAS-GSEA'

gsea_gs_atc_level4<-gsea_gs_atc_level4[,c("Name","log10_P","FDR_Sig","Nom_Sig","Method","Panel"), with=F]
